text: A wall of pinned charts. Arrows sweep
across the Hollow Sea in one long curl.
Someone has written: 'IT IS EARLY.'
A bank of humming machines. Rows of lamps
count something you cannot see.
A strip of tape reads: DO NOT UNPLUG. EVER.
A specimen tank, lit from beneath.
Something small turns over inside and
looks at you until you look away first.
The aide's bench. Flasks, a microscope,
and four months of water samples in a rack,
each one labelled with a place further inland.
A table on its own in the middle of the floor, and
nothing is allowed on it but the three sitting up there.
Dr. Vess dragged it out here himself and cleared it twice.
Three sets of field notes lie side by side on the table,
one for each of the three sitting above them.
Somebody has been awake a long time getting this right.
The working desks, pushed over to one side to clear
the middle of the room. There are four long scrapes
on the tile where something heavy was dragged out.
The long counter. Scrubbed pale, warm from the
lamp above it, and worn smooth in three places
where something small used to sit all morning.
